facts.value: ASU may offer conditional undergraduate admission to international applicants to an on-campus program who meet the academic (aptitude) and competency requirements, but are not proficient in English.

facts.value: This offer of conditional admission will give you time to improve your English proficiency before you start classes at ASU.

facts.value: Your conditional admission offer is good for up to three semesters.

facts.value: All international transcripts must be submitted in their original language accompanied by an official English translation. Translations must be literal, complete versions of the originals and must be translated by a university or government official or an official translation service. You may not complete your own translation.

metadata.chunk_title: I-20 updates

facts.value: It is extremely important that you submit the documents required for the issuance of your I-20 to us.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

facts.value: Upload the required documents through My ASU. The upload tool on My ASU only allows the upload of each document type once.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

facts.value: If you upload financial documents that do not cover the full funding needed as shown on the financial guarantee, you will be asked to submit additional documentation.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

facts.value: Once ASU has received all documents required to issue an I-20 and has verified that they are complete, you will receive an email with a link to download your I-20.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

facts.value: Be sure to check your non-ASU personal email address often, including junk and spam folders, so you do not miss any messages.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

facts.value: Once you have received your I-20, be sure to pay your I-901 fee.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

facts.value: Once the fee has been paid do not delay in contacting your consulate to obtain a visa appointment.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

facts.value: If you are unable to submit the documentation needed to receive an I-20 from ASU or are unable to obtain your F1 visa in time, contact [email protected] for advice on your options.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

facts.value: View the I-20 Frequently Asked Questions webpage for more information.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

facts.value: Be sure to check wait times for your local embassy or consulate, as some areas may be experiencing wait times longer than 30 days.
